Title: Azure Maps Data V1 / V2 APIs will be retired on 16 September 2024 – transition to Azure Maps Data Registry APIs

Body.Content:
Azure Maps Data V1 / V2 APIs will be retired on 16 September 2024 , please transition to Azure Maps Data Registry APIs by that date. 

 
  

Azure Maps team is retiring Data V1 / V2 APIs. In lieu, Azure Maps has deployed Data Registry APIs. The Data Registry APIs offer enhanced data security. To learn more about the Data Registry APIs please review the following link https://aka.ms/AzureMapsDataV1V2Retirement   
  
  
From now to 16 September 2024 you can continue to use Azure Maps Data V1 / V2 APIs without disruption. On 16 September 2024 — workloads running Azure Maps Data V1 / V2 APIs will be deleted and associated application data will be lost. Resources to aid in your migration can be found below. 

  

Required action   

To avoid service disruptions, please follow these (https://aka.ms/AzureMapsDataV1V2RetirementHowToCreateDataRegistry) instructions to migrate to Azure Maps Data Registry APIs by 9/15/2024.   

 

Help and support    

If you have questions, get answers from community experts Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, create a support request.
